The offense is "虚开发票罪" (illegal issuance of false invoices for tax deduction). Also possibly "诈骗罪"? Here it's false invoices for tax deduction, not contract fraud. So charge: "虚开发票罪". Also maybe "职务侵占罪"? He used his position to obtain illegal benefit. But the main crime is "虚开发票罪". Under Chinese law, there is also "非法经营罪"? No. The act is colluding to falsify invoices, which is a crime of "虚开发票罪". Could also be "受贿罪"? He took fees from others, but it's not public official. He is a company employee, not a public official. So not bribery. So single charge.
